jobs.title: Junior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about AI/ML, programming, and automation? Do you have technical expertise in design, software development, and modeling? Do you aspire to develop the next generation of AI business applications?

As a Data Scientist, you will collaborate with our data science and business teams to build state-of-the-art models, and perform exploratory analysis on new and existing data to identify, investigate, and solve challenges. You should be comfortable applying a variety of techniques to find the best results and capable of researching new methods to trial. You will work closely within a small team where collaboration is key to achieving our common goals.

• Collaborate with the business to assess opportunities for AI/data analytics technologies and maximize their value/impact for our clients.
• Support the design of AI/data analytics solution architecture and work with stakeholders to develop implementation roadmaps.
• Support AI/data analytics solution implementation and deployment.
• Develop, maintain, and deploy LLM, machine learning, and natural language processing pipelines and models with high performance, quality, and stability.
• Partner with the business to integrate AI and machine learning solutions across various strategic platforms. Models may span across a variety of domains, including but not limited to: LLM-based agentic AI architectures, natural language processing (e.g., document classification, named entity recognition, topic modeling, advanced and semantic information search, extraction), data analytics (predictive modeling, time-series analytics, pattern recognition, recommendation engines), computer vision (OCR), and voice recognition (speech-to-text).
• Research and build POCs for new and innovative AI solutions and technologies.

jobs.title: Operations Officer
jobs.description:
Are you a confident decision maker and problem solver? Do you know how to bring out the best in people?

We’re looking for an Operations Officer to:

• be an operational subject matter expert in the Market area
• assist in managing operational support staff
• educate all employees on operational policies and procedures
• manage operations-related client issues
• oversee operational tasks related to account opening and maintenance, funds received and disbursed, and margin/risk items
• monitor client accounts and transactions
• perform delegated supervisory functions, approvals and authorizations for the Market
• report into the Market Operations Officer aligned to the Market

This position requires full‑time, on‑site presence in the office.

titleByLocale.it: Tirocinio Quantitativo in Validazione dei Modelli Algoritmici

jobs.description:
Are you an innovative thinker who likes to challenge the status quo? Are you an engaged and motivated personality who likes to understand the big picture? For our global model validation and governance team we’re looking for an Intern who can:
• – assess a model's conceptual soundness and methodology
• – check appropriateness of assumptions, parameters, model calibrations, qualitative or expert adjustments
• – review outcome, impact, or benchmark analyses and develop a benchmark model (as appropriate)
• – assess model risk, including model robustness analysis and identification of limitations
• – document the analysis, findings and conclusion in a validation report
• – interact with stakeholders (e.g. model developer/owner, model governance committees, and senior management).

jobs.description:
Are you interested in generating new business? Are you strongly interested in the financial industry in particular investments? Are you tech- and data-savvy? Do you work accurately? We are looking for you!

As part of our RFP team, you’ll help respond to detailed client questionnaires that showcase our products, people, and investment strategies. These responses are key to winning new business and maintaining strong client relationships.

You’ll manage RFPs end-to-end, working with large datasets, automating repetitive tasks, and presenting insights clearly. A structured, analytical mindset and a willingness to learn are essential. While deep technical skills aren’t required, being comfortable with data analytics tools (see “Your Experience and Skills”) will help you deliver faster, more insightful responses.

The main tasks of your role are:
• To co-ordinate and produce accurate, timely RFPs, RFIs (Requests for Information) and DDQs (Due Diligence Questionnaires) for prospect clients and existing clients according to internal brand/style guidelines and compliance regulations.
• To collaborate closely with portfolio managers, investment specialists and subject matter experts to improve RFP answers, ensure key messages are understood, and present our capabilities in the most compelling way possible.
• To ensure the RFP database is kept up-to-date and accurate, and quality continually improved
• To help the team identifying and implementing digital solutions

jobs.title: Credit Risk Officer - Hedge Funds

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del Rischio di Credito - Hedge Funds

jobs.description:
Are you naturally curious and ambitious? Do you have sharp analytical skills and a background in counterparty credit risk in hedge funds?

We’re looking for a Credit Risk Officer like you who can:

• evaluate counterparty credit risk based on an understanding of the hedge fund and family office risk management techniques, trading strategies, and infrastructure, as well as a number of other quantitative and qualitative measures of credit worthiness. This will include client due diligence visits for onsite evaluations.
• hold delegated personal authority (within established risk-based limits) to approve new positions or to make recommendations to higher authority levels within Credit. The candidate will be expected to interact with the business units in relation to transactions to ensure the risk fit UBS's ultimate appetite in the sector.
• evaluate transactional risks associated with OTC derivatives, securities financing, exchange traded derivatives, banking products and structured transactions
• prepare, as well as review and approve, written counterparty annual reviews/transactional credit proposals drawing conclusions relating to credit assessment, risk appetite, exposure drivers and business prospects
• lead trading documentation negotiation including ISDA/CSA, Prime Brokerage and Repo Agreements
• ensure all regulatory requests, audit items and operational risk issues are dealt with in a disciplined, timely and efficient manner
• perform ad hoc credit risk analysis and participate in portfolio reviews to identify risk developments or concentrations

jobs.title: Intern in GRESC Sustainability
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for safeguarding the environment? Do you want to be part of the bank’s journey to net zero operations? Do you have a keen eye for efficiency to shape a lean approach to our decarbonization program?

We’re looking for a candidate who will:
• Support our Global Lead for Energy Management to develop a robust energy management system aligned with ISO 50001, building consensus with regional teams.
• Assist site and project teams to create comprehensive energy management plans and conduct measurement and verification assessments to demonstrate initiative effectiveness.
• Contribute to the evaluation of environmental risk management within the bank’s risk management framework, ensuring well-designed and executed mitigation plans.
• Co-ordinate Energy Management Governance regional working groups focused on decarbonization and meter data coverage of utility operations, progressing activities in line with agreed timelines and milestones.
• Analyse and calculate utility consumption to assist regional teams with consumption forecasts and renewable energy certificate purchases.

You will be directly involved in day-to-day project operations, gaining business-specific exposure from professionals with different areas of expertise within Group Real Estate and Supply Chain (GRESC). You’ll have the opportunity to see beyond your internship. If you’re ready to work where no two days are the same, this internship is for you.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Marketing Strategist to support the UBS Global Wealth Management (GWM) business across the APAC region. Working as part of the regional Market Coverage team, you will set a clear, data-informed direction for brand and marketing activation across APAC countries and segments, ensure alignment with divisional priorities, and orchestrate partnerships that amplify growth, reputation, and client impact.

Scope & Impact
• Work with the GWM regional marketing heads for Greater China, SEA/Japan and Australia and APAC Head of Marketing to shape the end-to-end Brand & Marketing planning process, integrating funnel goals and in-market priorities to deliver measurable outcomes.
• Partner with IB and AM Marketing coverage and Media and Communications teams to foster stronger cross-divisional coordination and One Bank brand and marketing initiatives
• Provide strategic guidance on value propositions, go-to-market strategies, key growth projects in partnership with the business and ensure narratives remain coherent and client-centric.
• Lead a team specialised in digital client acquisition marketing efforts, collaborating across functions, divisions and external partners to design and execute innovative campaigns that drive awareness, interest and engagement in new and existing audiences
• Work hand in hand with Marketing Excellence Labs (MELs), leveraging their expertise and insight for the benefit of the APAC region to deliver efficient and effective campaigns that grow existing clients and generate leads.
• Act as a senior marketing advisor with an increased focus on Australia as a new and valuable GWM book and where IB is already strong and Japan where the business across the Group is ambitious to grow further.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Planning
• Help define GWM’s multi-year marketing strategy and annual plan, including objectives by funnel stage and region, target-setting approach, and governance cadence.
• Translate strategic priorities into integrated campaign roadmaps, briefing requirements, and KPIs; ensure consistency between top-funnel brand goals and mid/bottom-funnel performance targets.
• Maintain a live portfolio view of programs, reallocating resources to the highest-impact opportunities amid constrained budgets and competitive noise.

Regional & Cross-Divisional Support
• Provide an objective APAC-wide perspective to avoid fragmented approaches and ensure cohesive regional strategy.
• Support a cross-divisional construct offering strategic advice and partnering with on-the-ground teams to deliver integrated outcomes. Seek out efficiencies by collaborating with IB, AM and P&C divisions to collectively achieve positive business and client outcomes.
• Bring to life regional on-the-ground knowledge of client behaviours and market dynamics for the benefit of all APAC country plans.

Briefing & Creative Excellence
• Co-create creative/media briefs that demand non-traditional ideas capable of breaking through clutter and driving earned amplification; steward agencies / internal teams to that quality bar.
• Ensure briefs specify funnel requirements by market and articulate how partners will support GWM to align targets and evaluation frameworks.

Measurement & Optimization
• Set and socialize measurement frameworks linking funnel progression to accelerate acquisition and business outcomes; run quarterly reviews to optimize mix, creative, and partnerships against target deltas.
• Champion test-and-learn performance marketing (new formats/channels, neuroscience or message testing) to continuously sharpen propositions and creative effectiveness.

• see that proper operational controls and procedures are implemented to move from test to production

• keep up to date with latest development best practices and proactively manage technical debt
• implement and manage infrastructure as code using tools like Terraform and ARM templates
• monitor and optimize the performance of Azure resources and services

jobs.title: Team Administrator
jobs.description:
The Team Administrator will lead operational, client service, and administrative functions for a high-performing financial advisor team serving ultra-high-net-worth clients. This individual serves as the operational backbone of the team—ensuring exceptional execution, leading risk and compliance initiatives, and a seamless client experience. The ideal candidate is a seasoned and decisive operations professional with deep knowledge of wealth management processes, strong leadership capabilities, an ability to navigate firm processes efficiently, and who can drive innovation with a technology-forward mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

• Client Service & Relationship Support: Deliver white-glove service for clients, partnering closely with the financial advisors to anticipate client needs and act discretion and responsiveness.

• Account Administration & Transactions: Oversee and execute a range of important administrative tasks including account openings, account maintenance, and transfers across multiple account types and entities, wires, disbursements, journals, and cash movements with precision and appropriate controls. Ensure timely and accurate processing of all client account paperwork

• Team Leadership & Development: Manage and develop operations and client service team members including setting priorities, workflow standards, and performance expectations for the operations team. Build a high accountability culture focused on excellence, efficiency, and client satisfaction and lead by example in a dynamic, high-expectation, in-office team environment

• Technology, Systems & Innovation: Serve as the team’s operations technology lead, with strong knowledge of platforms, systems, and workflows. Be the team champion for implementing firm-approved tools, platforms, and AI-driven solutions to drive efficiency, reduce risk, and enhance client experience

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law should be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

• Analyse von Fällen potenziell verdächtiger Aktivitäten, die von unseren Systemen gekennzeichnet sind. • Einbeziehung von Wirtschaftsakteuren in die Marktführungs- und andere Angelegenheiten. • Förderung kontinuierlicher Prozessverbesserungen und Beitrag zu strategischen Projekten und Automatisierungs-/Optimierungsinitiativen. • Durchführung von Überwachungsmaßnahmen im Bereich des Handels mit Informationsbarrieren für Firmen-, Kunden- und Personalkonten (PAD) Überwachung des Informationsflusses nichtöffentlicher Informationen (MNPI), um potenzielle Verstöße gegen die Informationsbarriererichtlinie, die eingeschränkte Liste und den Insiderhandel der Firma zu erkennen.

Vous êtes capable de penser de façon indépendante et d'exprimer vos opinions et idées avec confiance? Nous recherchons un analyste de surveillance commerciale dans un rôle de contributeur individuel avec l'expérience dans les domaines suivants : • Effectuer des activités de surveillance automatisées et manuelles de la conduite du marché dans l'ensemble de la division Investment Bank et Wealth Management.

• Analyser les cas d'activités potentiellement suspectes signalées par nos systèmes. • Engager avec les acteurs du marché sur les escalades liées à la conduite du marché et d'autres questions. • Entamer des améliorations continues des processus et contribuer à des projets stratégiques et des initiatives d'automatisation/optimisation. • Mener une surveillance des obstacles au commerce de l'information pour les entreprises, les clients et les transactions de compte personnel des employés (PAD) Surveiller la circulation des informations non publiques matérielles (MNPI) afin de détecter les éventuelles violations de la politique de la société sur les obstacles à l'information, la liste restreinte et les transactions d'initiés.
